assertions.text: feature+api, user@topic and release=next each get a `gh api -X DELETE repos/acme/widgets/git/refs/heads/<name>` command
`fix/a;touch x` and `feat/$(id)` appear in no command at all
The two rejected names are reported to the user as skipped, with a reason naming the ref-name check or shell metacharacters
The validation pattern used is ^[A-Za-z0-9._/@+=-]+$ (or an equivalent that admits @, + and =)
